verdict.rationale: Salesforce provides an official CLI (salesforcecli/cli) and an official MCP server for agent-based interaction, plus a generic 'Discover Salesforce APIs' page, and community comments praise its developer tooling (CLI, VS Code extensions, deployment). However, no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (all probed endpoints 404), so the API's public machine-readable documentation is not directly evidenced.
